output_fmt.title: Output Format
output_fmt.description: Format of the published recalibrated alignment. CRAM is smaller; it is written against the GATK.GRCh38 reference the alignment used.

cram_version.title: CRAM Version
cram_version.description: 3.0 is readable by essentially all tools. 3.1 is smaller, but some tools (including the coverage QC, which is then skipped) cannot read it.

quantize_quals_enabled.title: Quantize Quality Scores
quantize_quals_enabled.description: Replicate GATK ApplyBQSR static quantization after Parabricks applybqsr. Only the quantized file is published. Turn off to publish the unquantized recalibrated file instead.

preserve_qscores_less_than.title: Preserve Quality Scores Below
preserve_qscores_less_than.description: Quality scores below this value remain unchanged (GATK --preserve-qscores-less-than). Must be below the smallest bin.

round_down_quantized.title: Round Down
round_down_quantized.description: Round each score down to the largest bin at or below it, instead of the nearest bin in probability space (GATK --round-down-quantized).
